description: This file is a shell script used for device configuration and management in a network environment. It performs tasks such as fetching device properties, managing connectivity and security credentials, handling firmware updates, executing remote commands, and interacting with various configuration files and services. The script also includes logic for telemetry, error handling, and network communication with configuration servers.

methods.name: getReceiverId
methods.description: Retrieves the receiver ID from a specific data file.

methods.name: getChannelMapId
methods.description: Returns a static channel map ID.

methods.name: IsCodebigBlocked
methods.description: Checks if the Codebig connection attempts are currently blocked based on a timestamp file.

methods.name: get_Codebigconfig
methods.description: Configures whether to use Codebig or direct connection based on available features and previous failures.

methods.name: useDirectRequest
methods.description: Attempts to establish a connection to the server directly via HTTP/HTTPS, with retries and error handling.

methods.name: useCodebigRequest
methods.description: Attempts to establish a connection using Codebig, with retries, error handling, and blocking logic after failures.

methods.name: processJsonResponse
methods.description: Parses and reformats the JSON response from the configuration server into a readable local file format.

methods.name: sendHttpRequestToServer
methods.description: Sends an HTTP request to retrieve configuration data from a specified URL, handling different interface types.

methods.name: dropbearRecovery
methods.description: Restarts the Dropbear SSH server if it is not running, for remote management access.
